livestockCategoryId.description: Auto-generated primary key, framework convention (prefix/key/keyLength read by PrimaryKeyUtil). Matches the pattern and keyLength of the sibling cropcategoryPayloadValidation.json in the same repo. Generate via: python main.py --name livestock-category --action create (hyphenated, so the class/route come out as LivestockCategory / /livestockCategory, not flattened).
